description:
"The comfiest gravel bike I've ridden ever ... a lovely lovely bike ... one of the more fun and grin inducing gravel bikes I've ridden"
David Arthur - Just Ride Bikes YouTube review

- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
The last remaining stock of the Mk1 version of our fabulous Kite Ti framesets is now available at a special price.
Versatility is a virtue. In this age of increasing specialisation it’s easy to get sucked into the trap of thinking you need a gravel bike, a winter bike, a touring bike, a cross bike etc etc. The Kite can be all those things. Dress it up any way you please – plush 45mm tyres and ‘guards for winter roads, 30s for some summer speed, ‘cross tyres and hit a race or two, it can even take some full 29" or 27.5+ mtb tyres for some singletrack action. Maybe add some bags for a bikepacking epic. In whatever configuration the ride is sublime.
Frame

42/52 tapered internal headtube
Clearance for 700×55 or 650×60 (29×2.1" or 27.5×2.4") tyres
Double chainring 48-36 max (a double chainring may limit tyre clearance)
68mm BSA threaded bottom bracket shell
142×12 thru axle (axle supplied)
Bolt-on cable guides on underside of down tube
Three bottle cage mounts – seat tube, down tube, underside of down tube
27.2mm seat post (Hope seat tube clamp included)
Flat mount rear brake on the chainstay
Spare rear derailleur hanger supplied

Ti Fork

Tapered steerer (1.125" - 1.5")
Segmented construction
Flat mount brake 160-180mm rotor (i.e. +20mm for standard 140-160 brakes)
100x12 thru axle
Clearance for up to 700x58mm (29×2.3") tyres
Mudguard mounts
Triple cage mounts
Rack mounts
Dynamo cable routing in fork leg

These Kites are a production frameset - in stock and ready to ship. We continue to offer custom Ti Kites here - these frames have the attributes most commonly requested in our custom programme.

*Warranty is for the original owner only and is not transferable
